name: Scrap Maul
description: A heavy maul welded from a pipe and an engine block.
role: The close-combat weapon of Void Nomad raiders; slow but hard to stand up to.

artBrief.silhouette: Long handle with a big blocky head.
artBrief.detail: Weld seams, a rust-red head and cloth tape on the grip.
artBrief.paletteDirection: Rust reds, dark steel, dirty white tape.
artBrief.spriteScale: Held by a 2×2 cell character; drawn over its skin.
requiredVariants: 8 directions, each with idle and walk frames (the Object Layer direction set)
